fields.options:
Email Privacy Filter restricts who can read emails synced from M365 mailboxes. When enabled, each synced Communication is visible only to its linked user — even System Managers cannot view other users' emails (only the Administrator user bypasses this).

Emails with no linked_user (legacy data or shared mailboxes) remain visible to all users with normal Communication permissions, regardless of this setting.

fields.description: When enabled, M365-synced emails are visible only to the linked user. Default: off.
fields.label: Enable Email Privacy Filter
